subject: Request: remove prompt outputs & inference logs for SigmaHealth (GDPR deletion)
messages:
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@sigmahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: purge prompt outputs & inference logs for SigmaHealth - GDPR deletion

Hi Marissa,

We need Redwood to permanently remove all model prompt text, model outputs, and inference logs associated with the dataset ID SH-2025-CV1 and any derivative embeddings or cached KV state. This is a GDPR erasure request on behalf of a patient cohort; our legal team requires deletion evidence. Scope: all prompt/output logs, per-request traces, cache entries, ephemeral KV and embeddings produced between 2025-10-01 and 2026-07-31.

Please confirm the exact prefixes/IDs you will remove, the ops run ID for the purge, and provide an audit CSV that lists object keys and a manifest SHA256 so our privacy team can verify. Ideally we'd like this completed by COB 2026-08-05.

Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
Lena Brooks
Data Privacy Lead, SigmaHealth
Lena.Brooks@sigmahealth.com
(attachment: redacted-request.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@sigmahealth.com>
Cc: DataPrivacy <dataprivacy@sigmahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: purge prompt outputs & inference logs for SigmaHealth - GDPR deletion

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear scope. We're starting a deletion workflow and I want to confirm two quick points to avoid incomplete removals: 

1) Confirm that you want embeddings (vectorDB snapshots) removed as well as the raw prompt/output logs.
2) Can you provide the canonical bucket/prefix if you have one? Otherwise we'll target known prefixes for SH-2025-CV1 and the model inference logs tagged with customer_id: sigmahealth.

Planned steps:
- Create a deletion ticket (PR-20260803-92) and schedule an ops purge window (non-peak).
- Run a canary sweep to validate the deletion script on a small subset and produce a manifest.
- Execute full purge and produce an audit CSV plus SHA256 manifest hash.
- Rotate any short-lived KMS material used for the dataset and flush KV caches.

We expect to complete this within your requested window if there are no blockers. I'll loop in Ops now to schedule the run and will follow up with the ticket and estimated completion time.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(attachment: deletion-playbook-v2.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataPrivacy <dataprivacy@sigmahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:10:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: purge prompt outputs & inference logs for SigmaHealth - GDPR deletion

Evelyn, Jonas — forwarding a customer erasure request for scope SH-2025-CV1. Lena asked for full removal of prompt text, model outputs, per-request inference logs, embeddings and KV cache between 2025-10-01 and 2026-07-31. Customer expects evidence (manifest + SHA256) and ops run ID. They asked for completion by COB 2026-08-05.

Planned ops steps (please follow and confirm):
1) Canary run: PR-20260803-92-CAN (apply deletion script to 1% of matching keys) — validate no unintended prefixes are matched.
2) Full sweep: PR-20260803-92 (record all object keys removed to manifest CSV).
3) KMS rotation / key zeroization for dataset-specific DEKs and flush KV cache across serving nodes.
4) Produce audit CSV: sigmahealth-deletion-20260803.csv and compute SHA256 over manifest.
5) Post to the secure S3 manifest path and share link with customer.

Special notes: embeddings may live in two systems (vectorstore-s3 and redis-veccache). Please ensure both are included. If deletion is blocked by a legal hold flag, alert me immediately.

Quoted original request below.

On 2026-08-03T09:12:00Z Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@sigmahealth.com> wrote:
> We need Redwood to permanently remove all model prompt text, model outputs, and inference logs associated with the dataset ID SH-2025-CV1 ...

Jonas — can you pick up the canary and full sweep tomorrow morning? Evelyn — please coordinate KMS rotations and the manifest upload. Aim for completion and the audit CSV before 2026-08-05 COB.

Thanks,
Marissa
